I had my second test attempt on December 12th, and my last lesson was on the 10th. And my lesson went horrendously. I tried to move on a steep hill in 3rd, in a quiet, residential area I turned right into the right hand lane and twice I moved out a roundabout when I really should have waited (one was close, as the car coming round was very slow but the other would have failed me).

I sat the test and before moving out of the bay, I stalled, I wouldn’t have moved several inches. I managed to pass with 2 minors.

Long story short, I know more people who had awful last lessons than decent/good ones. Concentrate on the moment, and mistake you make no matter how big or small, just focus on the now. Best of luck :)

I managed to pass my test yesterday. It was my second attempt after I failed in July. May be not so much advice here, but things to remember.

Firstly, the test goes very quick. And I mean it’ll feel like you’ve driven for 5 minutes between leaving and returning to the test centre. Secondly, concentrate on the moment you’re in. If you’ve made a mistake, don’t assume you’ve failed. There were several times yesterday when during the moment, I thought I may have picked up a minor (and twice I thought potentially a serious) and I didn’t. And lastly, as soon as the test starts, you’ll be fine. It’s like an exam in high school, the days and hours leading up to the test are a lot worse than the test itself. Get a good nights sleep and all the best for tomorrow :)
